tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yer par bzhugs pa'i klu dbang sku'i 'dod gsol dge/ na mo gu ru bai ran shāsatrashtsa na gant+ra rakṣi tā ya/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan 'khon gyi gdung / /thog ma'i 'byung khungs 'od gsal lha yi rigs/ /rigs gsum rnam sprul sa skya pa zhes grags/ /grags pa don ldan bstan 'gro'i mgon yin phyir/ /gang de'i rigs 'khrungs phul byung lo tsā ba/ /padma'i gzhon dgra klu dbang srung ba zhes/ /skyabs mchog gu ru padma'i zhal lung brnyes/ /bo dhi sa twa'i sdom phrug chen po yi/ /ngo mtshar mdzad dgras dpal gyi yer pa ru/ /mchog gi mtshan ma rdor dril mkhar bzhag phug /dril bu'i ming can 'di zhes gleng ba de/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis/ /nyams gso bzhugs yun bskrun dang lhan cig par/ /rnam 'dren khyed sku gzungs dang rab gnas can/ /gang gi rigs kyi tha shal dkor zan pa/ /sngags 'chang kun dga' blo gros dbang sdud snying / /e waṃ bzang por bcas pa'i dad rten du/ /bskrun 'dod ji bzhin bskal bzang bstan don du/ /rab grags dad ldan slob ma bka' bcu sogs/ /'brel thogs 'ga' yis lha bzo mkhas pa'i phul/ /don grub phrin las 'gran nas legs bzhengs mthus/ /'chi med 'khon ston sa skya par gsol ba'i/ /'jam mgon pad dkar can dang rdo rje 'dzin/ /rnam sprul rgyun mi chad pa'i mkhas grub tu/ /kun la rlung ltar grags pa'i bla brgyud tshogs/ /spyi dang khyad par 'khon chen klu dbang srung / /dkon mchog snying po rtse mo grags pa dang / /kun dga' 'phags pa bdag nyid mtshan 'chang ba/ /bdag chen rdo rje 'chang dang sa lo chen/ /sngags 'chang bdud kyi stobs 'phrog rigs sras zung / /dbon dang yang dbon rim byon bye brag tu/ /a mes zhabs dang drin can rdo rje 'chang / /bsod nams rin chen zhabs sogs gdung rabs dang / /bstan 'dzin ngor rdzong gong tshar go shāka 'bum/ /sngags mdo'i shing rta 'jig rten mig gyur kun/

/yang phur bde kyai gsang ba shākya'i rgyal/ /gur mgon lcam dral zhal bzhi nor skyong zung / /las mkhan lnga dang dkar bdud phur srung sogs/ /rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs nas/ /bdag dang bdag la phyogs dus gnas skabs kun/ /'brel thogs spyi dang khyad par las 'di la/ /dad ldan rnams kyi sgrib byang tshogs rdzogs nas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug re smon lhun grub gsol/ /bstan 'gro spyi byer gnod sel dge tshogs spel/ /de kun 'khon ston rnams kyi thugs bskyed ni/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thugs smon las gzhan ci/ /de dang de bzhin 'gyur ba'ang de yis mdzod/ /skyabs chen bslu med byin dang rgyu 'bras bden/ /lhag bsam rten cing 'brel 'byung mi bslu bas/ /rten dang brten pa bskrun ltar snod bcud la/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu myur du 'byung bar mdzod// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ yer par bzhugs pa'i klu dbang sku'i 'dod gsol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
